HD1_PRIVATE_OS_INTERFACES.reason: The recipe and consumer use the public InChI C API, CMake, libc, libc++ and no private OpenHarmony OS interface.

HD2_PRIVATE_TOOLCHAIN.reason: The package builds with the public OHOS SDK/LLVM profile; the standard native self-sign tool is a W3 execution prerequisite, not a private compiler or proprietary source dependency.
